case_a_falling_price.title: Case A: Post-Harvest Supply Glut & Falling Price (Perishable Tomato)
case_a_falling_price.market_context: Supply glut drives mandi prices down from ₹1,300/q to ₹980/q over 14 days; transit spoilage increases to 16%.

naive_strategy.action: Hold 14 days hoping for rebound, then transport 85 km to Pune APMC

recommended_strategy.action: Harvest and sell immediately at local Junnar Mandi (0 km transit, 0% spoilage)

financial_advantage.loss_prevented_rationale: Avoided ₹320/q price drop and ₹15,680 spoilage loss plus ₹14,875 transit fee.

case_b_rising_price.title: Case B: Pre-Monsoon Scarcity & Rising Price (Storable Onion)
case_b_rising_price.market_context: Regional supply shortage. Price rises from ₹2,200/q to ₹2,850/q (+29.5%) over 14 days. Onion has low storage decay (2.4%).

naive_strategy.action: Sell immediately at nearest local mandi (Junnar) at spot rate

recommended_strategy.action: Store in on-farm chawl for 14 days, then haul to Pune APMC to capture regional price premium

financial_advantage.gain_rationale: Holding for 14 days captured ₹650/q gross upside, netting +₹39,812 (+19.2%) after storage and transit deductions.

case_c_weather_risk.title: Case C: Extreme Unseasonal Precipitation Threat (Field Tuber Protection)
case_c_weather_risk.market_context: Extreme weather forecast: 75 mm rain within 48h. Delay causes 35% field tuber rot and a 15% quality discount at mandi.

naive_strategy.action: Postpone harvest until after the rain passes (delayed harvest in wet soil)

recommended_strategy.action: Execute early harvest sprint within 48-hour window and liquidate at local Junnar depot

financial_advantage.loss_prevented_rationale: Prevented 35 quintals of catastrophic tuber rot and avoided quality docking, saving ₹62,790 (+154% over naive revenue).
